name: Exp_FatlSatlOsma
summary: This EA trades based on the FatlSatlOsma custom indicator, which is an OSMA-style oscillator derived from FATL (Fast Adaptive Trend Line) and SATL (Slow Adaptive Trend Line) digital filters. It opens long positions when the oscillator values show increasing momentum (Value[0] > Value[1] > Value[2] is not required, but Value[1] < Value[2] with Value[0] > Value[1]) and short positions on decreasing momentum, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于FatlSatlOsma自定义指标进行交易，该指标是由FATL（快速自适应趋势线）和SATL（慢速自适应趋势线）数字滤波器衍生的OSMA类振荡器。当振荡器值显示动量增加时开多仓，动量减少时开空仓，并配有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于FATL和SATL数字滤波器的差值振荡器（OsMA），通过检测振荡器斜率变化来判断动量方向转换。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（振荡器下降）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前值开始回升）时做多，表示动量从下降转为上升；当Value[1]>Value[2]（振荡器上升）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前值开始回落）时做空，表示动量从上升转为下降。出场条件依赖固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit参数，同时允许通过反向信号平仓（如做多时收到做空信号则平多仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金比例，支持LOT和MARGIN两种模式，由TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数实现。资金管理方面，MM默认0.1表示使用10%的可用资金，但没有最大持仓限制或风险敞口控制。策略在H12时间框架上运行，属于中长期动量反转交易，信号在指定SignalBar上获取以避免重绘问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on an OsMA-style oscillator derived from the difference between FATL (Fast Adaptive Trend Line, 39-period) and SATL (Slow Adaptive Trend Line, 65-period) digital filters, detecting momentum direction changes via oscillator slope transitions. Entry conditions: go long when Value[1]<Value[2] (oscillator was declining) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current value starts rising), indicating momentum shifting from bearish to bullish; go short when Value[1]>Value[2] (oscillator was rising) and Value[0]<Value[1] (current value starts falling), indicating momentum shifting from bullish to bearish. Exit conditions rely on fixed StopLoss (1000 points) and TakeProfit (2000 points) parameters, while also allowing reverse-signal exits (e.g., closing longs when a sell signal appears). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter governing capital allocation ratio, supporting both LOT and MARGIN modes via the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions. Money management defaults to MM=0.1 (10% of available funds), but lacks maximum position limits or overall exposure controls. The strategy operates on the H12 timeframe by default, classifying it as a medium-to-long-term momentum reversal system, with signals taken from a configurable SignalBar to avoid repainting issues.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数确定方式（固定手数或保证金比例）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing method (fixed lots or margin ratio)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取交易信号的K线编号

pros: 使用FATL/SATL数字滤波器，信号平滑度优于普通MA交叉，减少虚假信号
具备完整的止损止盈机制，风险可控
支持做多做空独立开关，交易灵活性高
使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易
SignalBar参数可调，避免指标重绘问题
pros_en: Uses FATL/SATL digital filters which produce smoother signals than standard MA crossovers, reducing false signals
Has complete stop loss and take profit mechanism with controllable risk per trade
Supports independent on/off switches for long and short entries/exits, providing high trading flexibility
Implements new bar detection to prevent repeated trading within the same bar
Configurable SignalBar parameter avoids indicator repainting issues
cons: 依赖自定义指标FatlSatlOsma，缺少该指标文件则EA无法运行
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，对大多数品种不适合，需要手动优化
没有持仓数量检查，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
缺乏点差过滤，在点差较大时可能不利入仓
资金管理仅控制单笔比例，无整体风险敞口限制
没有追踪止损或移动止盈机制，无法锁定浮盈
cons_en: Depends on the custom FatlSatlOsma indicator file; EA cannot run without it
Default StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are excessively large for most instruments and require manual optimization
No position count check exists, potentially allowing duplicate entries in the same direction
Lacks spread filtering, which may cause unfavorable entries during high-spread conditions
Money management only controls per-trade allocation ratio with no overall portfolio exposure limit
No trailing stop or dynamic take-profit mechanism to lock in floating profits
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓，并限制最大同时持仓数量
添加追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时保护浮盈
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免不利条件下入场
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction and limit maximum concurrent positions
Implement a trailing stop feature to protect floating profits during trend continuation
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid entering under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 没有持仓数量检查，可能重复开仓导致过度敞口
默认止损止盈点数过大，若未优化可能造成巨额亏损或错失利润
依赖外部自定义指标和TradeAlgorithms库，缺少任何一文件导致初始化失败
risk_points_en: No position count check may allow duplicate entries leading to excessive exposure
Default SL/TP values are very large; without optimization they can cause significant losses or missed profits
Dependency on external custom indicator and TradeAlgorithms library; missing any file causes initialization failure
